newsitem.title: USA: First Central sees net loss for 1996.
newsitem.headline: First Central sees net loss for 1996.

text.p: First Central Financial Corp said on Friday it expects to take a $11.5 million charge for its fourth quarter and will report a net loss of about $9.7 million for full-year 1996.
The preliminary estimates -- still subject to change, the company said -- indicated a net loss per share of $1.62 for the year.
The company also said it would not be able to pay any dividends "for the foreseeable future."

In addition, First Central said that unless it obtains another source of funds it will be unable to make its August 1 interest payment of $220,500 and its sinking fund obligation of $1.8 million under its nine percent convertible subordinated debentures.
The charge to be recorded for the quarter ending December 31 was to increase loss reserves at First Central's principle subsidiary, First Central Insurance Co, a property and casualty insurer.
Full financial results will be reported by March 10.
